title: Mine With Ragdolls (FWR Pack)
description: This resource pack aims to add building blocks, music, signs and other stuff from Fun With Ragdolls: The Game & Fun With Ragdolls: Plus.
body:
This resource pack adapts visual elements inspired by Fun with Ragdolls: The Game and Fun with Ragdolls Plus for use in Minecraft. It focuses on clean, simplified textures with strong shading and solid forms, reflecting the experimental sandbox aesthetic of the original games.

The goal of the pack is to provide a cohesive visual style that feels structured and functional while still capturing the distinctive look of physics-based environments. It is designed to integrate smoothly with standard Minecraft gameplay and building.
